<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## AITER prerequisites

- [ROCm/aiter#6260](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6260) — the matching rocminfo and JIT boot fix inside AITER (empty `rocminfo`, live device properties, generic torch streams). #6203, #6204 and #6205 are the older split of the same work.

SGLang's memory-capacity read does not import AITER. AITER still fails its own device probe on these hosts without #6260.

## Motivation

`get_amdgpu_memory_capacity()` reads the VRAM size from `rocminfo`. On some hosts `rocminfo` stops before it prints the pool sizes. The server then fails at startup with `ValueError: could not convert string to float: ''` (empty output) or `RuntimeError: rocm-smi error` (non-zero exit), even though the GPUs work.

## Modifications

- Skip lines that `rocminfo` prints without a number.
- If no line has a size, read `total_memory` from the live HIP devices and log a warning.
- Keep the existing error when `rocminfo` is not installed.
- Add CPU unit tests for parsing, empty or failed `rocminfo`, and the no-device error.

## Accuracy Tests

This only changes how the memory size is read. When `rocminfo` works, the result is the same as before.

GSM8K, 5-shot, 1319 questions:

| Base | This PR |
|---:|---:|
| 0.951 | 0.940 |

GSM8K varies by about 0.01 between runs of the same serving code on this setup (0.950 vs 0.942, and 0.951 vs 0.940, for pairs of branches whose serving path is identical), so a difference of that size is noise.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No speed change is expected. `rocminfo` works on the test host, so both runs take the old path; the sweep confirms there is no regression.

MI355X x8, TP8, `/data/models/Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, AITER [`yuychang/aiter@b9229988f`](https://github.com/yuychang/aiter/commit/b9229988f) (upstream AITER `main` plus [ROCm/aiter#6260](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6260); #6203–#6205 are the older split of that boot fix). Base and PR ran back to back on the same machine with the Kimi-K3 8K/1K recipe: random 8192 in / 1024 out, 4 waves per concurrency, `--disable-radix-cache`, 16K chunked prefill, FP8 KV cache, AITER prefill and decode attention. This recipe differs from the cookbook MI355X cell: TP8 without DCP8. Speed and GSM8K each used a fresh server.

| Conc | TPOT (ms) base | TPOT (ms) PR | Δ | TTFT (ms) base | TTFT (ms) PR | Δ | Throughput (tok/s/GPU) base | Throughput (tok/s/GPU) PR | Δ |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2 | 18.39 | 18.42 | +0.2% | 776 | 777 | +0.1% | 117.6 | 117.4 | -0.2% |
| 4 | 20.15 | 20.17 | +0.1% | 1258 | 1261 | +0.2% | 210.7 | 210.4 | -0.1% |
| 8 | 22.96 | 22.99 | +0.1% | 2078 | 2084 | +0.3% | 360.4 | 359.9 | -0.1% |
| 16 | 28.12 | 28.18 | +0.2% | 3602 | 3609 | +0.2% | 569.3 | 568.1 | -0.2% |
| 32 | 35.46 | 35.51 | +0.1% | 6622 | 6631 | +0.1% | 859.1 | 858.0 | -0.1% |
| 64 | 50.36 | 50.45 | +0.2% | 12670 | 12680 | +0.1% | 1148.4 | 1146.6 | -0.2% |

Tests (MI355X): `test_amdgpu_memory_capacity.py` (5, CPU, mocked `rocminfo` and HIP devices), passing. On the base, 4 of the 5 fail. On MI355X with `rocminfo` mocked to print nothing, this PR returns 294896 MiB, the same value the real `rocminfo` gives.

+def _amdgpu_memory_mib_from_torch(reason: str) -> float:
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.device_count() < 1:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{reason} and no HIP device is visible.")
+    # Callers compare this MiB value with N*1024.
+    capacity = min(
+        torch.cuda.get_device_properties(i).total_memory / (1024 * 1024)
+        for i in range(torch.cuda.device_count())
+    )
+    logger.warning("%s; using %.0f MiB from the live HIP device", reason, capacity)
+    return capacity

+def _rocminfo(stdout: str, returncode: int = 0, stderr: str = ""):
+    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(
+        args="rocminfo", returncode=returncode, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr
+    )
+
+
+class TestGetAmdgpuMemoryCapacity(CustomTestCase):
+    """rocminfo pool sizes are in KB; an empty or failed rocminfo falls back to
+    the smallest live HIP device. Subprocess and torch.cuda are mocked."""
+
+    def _capacity(self, rocminfo, *total_mib):
+        props = [SimpleNamespace(total_memory=t * 1024 * 1024) for t in total_mib]
+        cuda = common.torch.cuda
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(common.subprocess, "run", return_value=rocminfo),
+            mock.patch.object(cuda, "is_available", return_value=bool(props)),
+            mock.patch.object(cuda, "device_count", return_value=len(props)),
+            mock.patch.object(
+                cuda, "get_device_properties", side_effect=lambda i: props[i]
+            ),
+        ):
+            return get_amdgpu_memory_capacity()
+
+    def test_reads_smallest_rocminfo_pool(self):
+        out = "301989888(0x12000000) KB\n301465600(0x11f80000) KB\n"
+        self.assertEqual(self._capacity(_rocminfo(out)), 301465600 / 1024)
+
+    def test_skips_lines_without_a_size(self):
+        out = "\n301989888(0x12000000) KB\nN/A\n"
+        self.assertEqual(self._capacity(_rocminfo(out)), 301989888 / 1024)
+
+    def test_empty_rocminfo_falls_back_to_hip(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._capacity(_rocminfo(""), 294896, 294800), 294800)
+
+    def test_failed_rocminfo_logs_stderr_and_falls_back_to_hip(self):
+        failed = _rocminfo("", returncode=1, stderr="hsa init failed")
+        with self.assertLogs(common.logger, level="WARNING") as logs:
+            self.assertEqual(self._capacity(failed, 294896), 294896)
+        self.assertIn("hsa init failed", logs.output[0])
+
+    def test_no_rocminfo_and_no_device_raises(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
+            self._capacity(_rocminfo(""))
+
